title: MoMPy: automated construction of moment matrices for semidefinite programming relaxations
summary: We present MoMPy, an open-source Python package that provides a unified, declarative construction of moment matrices for semidefinite programming (SDP) hierarchies. The user declares operator labels together with a small set of structural relations, and MoMPy returns a matrix of SDP variable indices in which every implied identification has already been made, ready for CVXPY or any other modelling layer.
